lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice summarizing a very simple news or media item with jag läste att.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague mentions an accessible news item, local update, or short article during a break.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing the main point of something read or heard.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about a simple article or local news item and connect it to everyday life.

main_focus.name: summary with jag läste att or jag hörde att
main_focus.description: Use an att-clause to give the main point of a simple piece of information.
model_examples: Jag läste att det ska bli kallare i helgen.
Jag hörde att en ny busslinje börjar snart.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use jag läste att or jag hörde att naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: future with ska or kommer att

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Keep the media item concrete and tied to everyday consequences.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person brings up a simple article or local update.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize the main point and discuss what it means practically.
dialogue_shape.ending: They give a brief opinion or decide whether the information matters to them.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat summary frames, not news details

focus: the main point of the news or media item
why the information matters in everyday life
the opinion or practical reaction to the information

sentence_focus: one sentence with jag läste att
one sentence with jag hörde att
one sentence saying what something is about
one sentence giving a simple opinion about the information
one sentence connecting the information to a practical effect
